findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: decker.validate_intent, decker.place_order · Private data: decker.place_order · Public sink: decker.validate_intent · Destructive: decker.get_assembly, decker.get_episodes, decker.place_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: decker.validate_intent, decker.place_order · Private data: decker.place_order · Public sink: decker.validate_intent · Destructive: decker.get_assembly, decker.get_episodes, decker.place_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
